model_annotations.Bulgarian: Тази диаграма е многослойна кръгова диаграма, която показва класификацията на видовете персонажи. Диаграмата се състои от 4 основни сектора, като общият брой на включените категории е 15. Големият външен кръг е разделен на четири сектора, етикетирани като "Virtual Characters", "Real Characters", "Characters" и "Custom Characters", като последният е с цвят розово. Вътрешният кръг е разделен на още по-малки сектори, които са етикетирани като "Comic Characters", "Game Characters", "Novel Characters", "Influencers", "Actors", "Musicians", "Writers", "Athletes", "Artists" и "Scientists". Някои от секторите са визуално разграничени с различни цветове, като "Custom Characters" е в розово, а останалите са в различни нюанси на синьо и зелено. Диаграмата включва етикети за всеки сектор, но не включва легенда или проценти.
model_annotations.English: The chart represents a comparison of character categories. There are 16 slices shown in total. The largest slice, "Virtual Characters", is light blue and accounts for approximately 37.5% of the chart. Within the "Virtual Characters" category, there are five sub-slices: "Comic Characters" with a light blue color covering around 25%, "Characters" with a slightly darker blue shade taking up around 6.25%, "Novel Characters" with a similar blue shade to "Characters" covering around 3.125%, and "Game Characters" with the same blue shade as "Comic Characters" covering around 3.125%. The next largest slice is "Custom Characters", pink, covering around 25%. The remaining portion, "Real Characters", is green and covers approximately 37.5%. Within "Real Characters", there are eight sub-slices of varying sizes and colors: "Scientists", "Artists", and "Athletes" are very small light green slices; "Writers", and "Musicians" are small light green slices; "Actors" and "Influencers" are medium-sized light green slices. A legend is not present but the chart labels each slice directly. No slices appear visually emphasized beyond standard coloring and sizing for proportion. The segments appear ordered by size with larger categories more prominent.
model_annotations.German: The diagram is a Venn-style chart comparing and contrasting real and virtual characters. It consists of two main sections, a larger inner circle and a smaller outer circle, with 2 and 11 segments, respectively. The inner circle has two segments: "Virtual Characters", colored blue, and "Real Characters", colored green; the "Virtual Characters" segment accounts for approximately 70% of the inner circle, while "Real Characters" makes up the remaining 30%. The outer circle has 11 segments, which are arranged in no apparent order, and include "Influencers", "Actors", "Musicians", "Writers", "Athletes", "Artists", "Scientists", all colored various shades of green, as well as "Game Characters", "Novel Characters", and "Comic Characters", colored various shades of blue; "Custom Characters" is colored red and accounts for a small portion of the outer circle. The chart does not contain a legend, but some segments include percentage values. The segments of the outer circle are not arranged in any specific order, such as descending size.
